title: Artifact Integrity and ZIP Protocol Documentation

prior_issue.complaint: Pass 3 bundle had artifact metadata mismatch (reviewer saw 549 vs 547 entries)
prior_issue.root_cause: build_pass3_zip.py creates zip-file-list.txt AFTER the ZIP; zip-file-list.txt itself is NOT included in the ZIP because it's created post-build
prior_issue.protocol_violation: Bundle was built, then build_pass3_zip.py was committed, creating a post-ZIP commit

artifact_staging_convention.rule_1: Tracked files committed first — NO tracked file modified after final commit
artifact_staging_convention.rule_2: final_commit_sha NOT embedded in tracked files (self-reference impossible)
artifact_staging_convention.rule_3: Artifact-metadata generated POST-COMMIT outside tracked repo (to .local/ gitignored)
artifact_staging_convention.rule_4: ZIP includes tracked files + artifact-metadata/ (bundle-manifest, final-clean-proof, artifact-verification, zip-file-list)
artifact_staging_convention.rule_5: git status --short MUST be clean before ZIP build
artifact_staging_convention.rule_6: ZIP built last, no commit after ZIP build
artifact_staging_convention.source: Healing Sprint 1F convention — confirmed and maintained in all subsequent sprints

sha256_sidecar_protocol.current_state: No per-file SHA256 sidecar; zip-file-list.txt contains paths only
sha256_sidecar_protocol.improvement: Future sprint: add sha256-manifest.json alongside zip with SHA256 of every entry
sha256_sidecar_protocol.implementation: Use hashlib.sha256 on each file before adding to ZIP; write separate manifest

pass3_entry_count_reconciliation.prior_reviewer_complaint: 549 vs 547 — reviewer may have read an earlier intermediate state
pass3_entry_count_reconciliation.resolution: 549 is correct (545 tracked + 4 metadata); 547 would have been before zip-file-list.txt was added to metadata

this_sprint_zip_protocol.plan: Build ZIP after ALL commits; artifact-metadata generated post-commit; entries will be counted accurately
